notes.title: Release date announced + New Prologue!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39741292/0a343c72bc60a84dd51664f2c18d6fb44f60b6fb.gif

Hi all,
The news you've all been waiting for has arrived... 
We are happy to announce that The Plane Effect will be releasing on PC, Ninendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X on August 12th 2021. 

You will be able to play through the entirety of Solo's mind-bending adventure in just a few weeks! 
But if you can't wait... You can experience the first 30-minutes right now with the Plane Effect Prologue!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1684510/The_Plane_Effect_Prologue/

We hope you enjoy! While you're waiting for your prologue to download, take a look at the opening animation, detailing Solo's day just before the start of the game!

[previewyoutube=gOove3PZWa0;full][/previewyoutube]
